title: Your Morning in Ancient Rome
hook: Your Roman morning starts before sunrise
claimsToVerify: Many Romans lived in multi-storey apartment blocks (insulae) with fire risk
Typical breakfast (ientaculum) was simple: bread, cheese, olives
Most residents fetched water from public fountains
Clients greeted their patrons at dawn (salutatio) wearing a toga
Many Romans finished business by early afternoon and went to the baths

scenes.text: It's still dark. You wake on a straw mattress in a tiny room, high up in a crowded apartment block.
scenes.imagePrompt: Dim ancient Roman apartment room at dawn, straw mattress, small oil lamp glowing

scenes.text: There's no kitchen up here, and fire is a real danger in these buildings. So you skip cooking.
scenes.imagePrompt: Narrow multi-storey Roman apartment building at night with a single lit window

scenes.text: Breakfast is simple. Bread, maybe some cheese or olives, grabbed on your way out.
scenes.imagePrompt: Roman street food stall with bread, cheese and olives in morning light

scenes.text: Water comes from a public fountain down the street. Almost nobody has a tap upstairs.
scenes.imagePrompt: Roman street fountain with people filling jugs at sunrise

scenes.text: If you work for a rich patron, you put on your toga and go greet him at his house, at dawn.
scenes.imagePrompt: Crowd of men in togas waiting at the entrance hall of a wealthy Roman villa

scenes.text: He might hand you food or a little money. Or he might just make you wait.
scenes.imagePrompt: Roman atrium with a wealthy patron seated and clients standing in line

scenes.text: Many people wrapped up business by early afternoon, then headed to the baths. Want to see that part?
scenes.imagePrompt: Roman public baths with steam and bathers relaxing, warm light
